selection: Exactly four historical DeepSeek M3 SELECTION.json cells, each in P0 and P1 H1 once; reuse H0 history.
planner: Decision 1 reuses exact frozen M1 broad plan; decisions 2-4 request a new no-tool plan from current real history using the unchanged M1 diagnostic prompt. No repair of malformed output.
actor: Current real history plus latest descriptive card; old cards and planner messages excluded. Same original tool schema and all actions enabled; four Actor decisions maximum.
no_gain_search: A P1 Search call with zero new D# in its returned result; count each call and note whether another call in the same batch gained D#.
transition: At a subsequent Actor decision, Inspect is any valid Find or Open. Calls in the same batch as a no-gain Search are not feedback responses. Report next-decision Search and Inspect separately; both may occur in mixed batches.
plan_realization: At least one action matching current plan scope: corpus/search, document/find, window/open, stop/natural no-call response. Report first call and conflicting calls as well.
source_compatibility: Judge Inspect's D# against the current active need using only current prefix and observed source windows, not entity name overlap. Record a reason per Inspect; uncertain is allowed.
evidence_gain: A Find/Open observation directly answers, supports, refutes or materially narrows the current active need. Separately record compatible but non-gaining inspection.
failure: Provider, planner parse, schema, tool and harness errors are distinct; no selective retry or forced final answer.
